result.topic_en: A short calculation of the mixed second partial derivative with respect to u and v of cos a' (or a similar trigonometric function of an angle a'), expressed through derivatives of r' and r'' and the cosines of the angles a' and a''.
result.transcription:
$\frac{\partial^2 \cos a'}{\partial u \partial v} = -\cos a'' \frac{\partial \left(\frac{1}{r''}\frac{\partial r'}{\partial v}\right)}{\partial v} \cos a'' - \frac{1}{r''}\frac{\partial r'}{\partial v} \cdot - \frac{p}{\Delta}[?] - \frac{1}{r'}\frac{\partial r''}{\partial u} \cos a'$
$= \frac{\partial \frac{1}{r'}\frac{\partial r''}{\partial u}}{\partial u} \cos a'' + \frac{1}{r'}\frac{\partial r''}{\partial u} \frac{1}{r''}\frac{\partial r'}{\partial v} \cos a'$

methods.what: Computation of the mixed second partial derivative of cos a' with respect to u and v in terms of r', r'' and their derivatives
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial^2 \cos a'}{\partial u \partial v} = -\cos a'' \frac{\partial \left(\frac{1}{r''}\frac{\partial r'}{\partial v}\right)}{\partial v} \cos a'' - \frac{1}{r''}\frac{\partial r'}{\partial v} \cdot - \frac{p}{\Delta}[?] - \frac{1}{r'}\frac{\partial r''}{\partial u} \cos a'$

methods.what: Alternative expression for the same mixed derivative, obtained by differentiating in the other order
methods.quote: $= \frac{\partial \frac{1}{r'}\frac{\partial r''}{\partial u}}{\partial u} \cos a'' + \frac{1}{r'}\frac{\partial r''}{\partial u} \frac{1}{r''}\frac{\partial r'}{\partial v} \cos a'$
